files.purpose: Maintainer documentation for the three pre-baked assets that style the Finder window shown when a Droppy Code DMG is mounted; it records the load-bearing name and geometry invariants baked into the .DS_Store and gives the exact shell recipe for re-rendering the background art and re-baking the .DS_Store with dmgbuild.
key_symbols: Heading '# Droppy Code installer (DMG) window styling'
Asset table rows: installer-background.tiff, installer-DS_Store.base64, built app's AppIcon.icns
calls_into: scripts/package_dmg.sh (stages the assets into every release DMG; also runs the /Volumes/Droppy Code alias check and refuses an asset that fails it)
tiffutil -cathidpicheck, hdiutil attach -nobrowse -readonly -mountpoint, hdiutil detach, base64 -b 76, base64 -d, strings, grep, python3 -m venv, open
side_effects: Documents commands that write to /tmp/dmg-art, /tmp/dmgvenv, /tmp/dmgbake and /tmp/droppy-code.dmg
Documents commands that attach and detach a disk image at /tmp/dmgbake/mnt
Documents overwriting release/dmg/installer-background.tiff and release/dmg/installer-DS_Store.base64 in the repository
platform_assumptions: macOS Finder window styling driven by a .DS_Store baked on an HFS+ volume
Finder resolves background aliases by volume name plus path, so an alias baked against a throwaway volume keeps working for every future DMG even though it carries that volume's creation date
Finder silently falls back to a default window if any referenced name changes
macOS-only tooling: tiffutil, hdiutil, open, swift used as a script interpreter, /Applications, /Volumes
HiDPI TIFF built by combining the 1x and 2x PNGs with tiffutil -cathidpicheck
persisted_fields: /.background.tiff (staged path of the HiDPI background on the mounted volume)
/.VolumeIcon.icns (copied from the built app's Contents/Resources/AppIcon.icns at package time so it always matches the shipped icon)
ui_elements: Volume name must stay 'Droppy Code' because the background image alias stores it
App bundle must be 'Droppy Code.app' and the symlink 'Applications'; icon positions are keyed by those names
Window content is 660x370 with icon centers at (165, 208) and (495, 208); WindowBounds is 660x398 to account for the titlebar
feature_notes: Explicit statement that nothing in release/dmg runs at release time: the assets are pre-baked and only staged by scripts/package_dmg.sh
installer-DS_Store.base64 is deliberately kept as base64 text so git and reviews treat it as source rather than an opaque binary
Re-baking the .DS_Store is required only if geometry changed: window size, icon positions, icon size, or any renamed path
Any mounted 'Droppy Code' volume must be ejected before baking, otherwise the bake volume mounts as 'Droppy Code 1' and the alias records that name
Verification command: base64 -d < release/dmg/installer-DS_Store.base64 | strings | grep Volumes must print /Volumes/Droppy Code
Render step also produces /tmp/dmg-art/preview-mock.png, opened to judge the design with icons composited

Bake recipe: dmgbuild -s /tmp/dmgbake/dmgbuild_settings.py -D here=/tmp/dmgbake "Droppy Code" /tmp/dmgbake/baked.dmg, then base64 -b 76 < /tmp/dmgbake/mnt/.DS_Store > release/dmg/installer-DS_Store.base64
Bake stub is created at /tmp/dmgbake/stub/Droppy Code.app/Contents/MacOS
Final verification step: scripts/package_dmg.sh --app "/Applications/Droppy Code.app" --output /tmp/droppy-code.dmg
unresolved_questions: The exact flags and checks inside scripts/package_dmg.sh are only described here, not shown; that script is outside this bundle.
installer-background.tiff itself is not in this bundle, so its actual pixel dimensions (expected 660x430 at 1x given the 60pt export bleed) are not verified here.

files.purpose: The dmgbuild settings module used only when re-baking release/dmg/installer-DS_Store.base64; it declares the volume name, image format, filesystem, window rectangle, icon-view options and icon coordinates that get frozen into the baked volume's .DS_Store.
key_symbols: HERE = os.path.abspath(defines.get("here", "."))  # noqa: F821 - injected by dmgbuild
calls_into: dmgbuild's injected 'defines' global; the file is exec()'d without __file__, so -D here=<this directory> must be passed
<HERE>/stub/Droppy Code.app, a throwaway stub whose NAME is the only thing baked
state_owned: HERE: absolute path of the bake directory, default "."
show_status_bar = False, show_tab_view = False, show_toolbar = False, show_pathbar = False, show_sidebar = False
icon_size = 128, text_size = 12, show_icon_preview = False, arrange_by = None
side_effects: None directly; when exec()'d by dmgbuild it drives creation of a UDZO/HFS+ disk image and copies installer-background.tiff onto the volume as /.background.tiff
platform_assumptions: HFS+ filesystem and UDZO compressed disk image, both macOS-only concepts
Finder icon-view window attributes (status bar, tab view, toolbar, pathbar, sidebar, icon preview, arrange-by) are Finder concepts with no Windows equivalent
dmgbuild's exec() model provides no __file__, hence the -D here=<dir> define
persisted_fields: show_status_bar / show_tab_view / show_toolbar / show_pathbar / show_sidebar / show_icon_preview: bool = False
ui_elements: Finder window at screen origin (420, 240), outer size 660x398 (content 660x370 plus roughly 28pt of titlebar)
Icon view with 128pt icons and 12pt label text; no status bar, tab view, toolbar, pathbar or sidebar; no icon preview; no arrange-by
Disk item 'Droppy Code.app' centered at (165, 208) and the 'Applications' symlink centered at (495, 208)
feature_notes: Header comment states the file is 'Not used at release time' and only (re)bakes the checked-in .DS_Store base64
Comment: 'Geometry must stay in lockstep with generate_installer_background.swift: window content: 660x370 (WindowBounds adds ~28pt of titlebar)'
Comment: 'Any minimal stub named Droppy Code.app works: only the NAME is baked into .DS_Store.'
Comment: dmgbuild copies the background to /.background.tiff and the baked alias points there, so scripts/package_dmg.sh must keep staging it at that path
unresolved_questions: dmgbuild's version is not pinned here (the README installs it unpinned with pip), so which dmgbuild release produced the checked-in .DS_Store cannot be determined from these files.

files.purpose: A standalone '#!/usr/bin/env swift' script that renders the DMG window background artwork at 1x and 2x plus a Finder-like preview composite, drawing a flat near-black canvas, an accent radial glow, a notch silhouette hanging from the top edge, the 'Droppy Code' wordmark, a drag arrow and a 'Drag to install' caption.
key_symbols: backgroundColor, textPrimary, accent (NSColor srgb brand tokens)
calls_into: AppKit: NSColor(srgbRed:green:blue:alpha:), NSColor(white:alpha:), NSColor.black, NSFont.systemFont(ofSize:weight:), NSAttributedString.draw(at:), NSBitmapImageRep(cgImage:), NSBitmapImageRep.representation(using: .png, properties:), NSGraphicsContext(cgContext:flipped:), NSImage(contentsOfFile:), NSImage.draw(in:from:operation:fraction:respectFlipped:hints:), NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile:)

Foundation: FileManager.default.createDirectory(at:withIntermediateDirectories:), FileHandle.standardError.write, URL(fileURLWithPath:isDirectory:), appendingPathComponent, Data.write(to:), CommandLine.arguments, exit(64)

side_effects: Creates the output directory with createDirectory(withIntermediateDirectories: true)
Writes <outputDir>/installer-background.png at scale 1 and height canvasH + exportBleed
Writes <outputDir>/installer-background@2x.png at scale 2 and height canvasH + exportBleed
Writes <outputDir>/preview-mock.png at scale 2 and height canvasH
Writes the usage line to stderr and exits with code 64 when CommandLine.arguments.count < 2
Reads an .icns from the optional third argument, else /Applications/Droppy Code.app/Contents/Resources/AppIcon.icns, else NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: "/Applications/Droppy Code.app")
Reads NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: "/Applications") for the Applications folder icon
Prints 'Rendered installer background + preview into <outputDir.path>' on success
fatalError("Could not create bitmap context"), fatalError("Could not snapshot bitmap context"), fatalError("PNG encode failed") on failure
platform_assumptions: macOS AppKit plus CoreGraphics; executed with the Swift toolchain as a script
NSWorkspace icon lookup for /Applications and /Applications/Droppy Code.app
.icns icon format for the app icon
macOS system font (San Francisco) at weights .semibold, .medium and default; text metrics depend on the system font
sRGB color space, CGImageAlphaInfo.premultipliedLast bitmap, NSGraphicsContext(flipped: true) plus a manual translate/scale flip to get a top-left origin
persisted_fields: preview-mock.png: rendered at scale 2 with height canvasH, so 1320x740 px
ui_elements: Canvas 660x370pt, exported at 660x430pt; the 60pt flat-color bleed exists so no interpretation of Finder's WindowBounds can expose an unpainted strip that would render white in light mode, and Finder anchors backgrounds top-left
backgroundColor = NSColor(srgbRed: 0x0b/255, green: 0x0e/255, blue: 0x14/255, alpha: 1), the site's near-black canvas
textPrimary = NSColor(srgbRed: 0xe8/255, green: 0xea/255, blue: 0xed/255, alpha: 1)
accent = NSColor(srgbRed: 0x4f/255, green: 0x9c/255, blue: 0xff/255, alpha: 1)
Accent glow: radial gradient with stops accent at alpha 0.16 and accent at alpha 0, locations [0, 1], context translated to (canvasW/2, 4), scaled by (1, 0.42), startRadius 0, endRadius 210
Notch silhouette in NSColor.black: centerX canvasW/2, width 150, height 27, cornerRadius 10, filletRadius 7, outward quad-curve fillets at the top edge
Wordmark 'Droppy Code' in systemFont ofSize 31 weight .semibold, color textPrimary, centered at (canvasW/2, 88)

Arrow: NSColor(white: 1, alpha: 0.32), lineWidth 2.5, round cap and join, arrowY = 208, arrowStart = 250.75, arrowEnd = 400.75, chevron legs at (arrowEnd - 11, arrowY - 9) and (arrowEnd - 11, arrowY + 9)
Caption 'Drag to install' in systemFont ofSize 12 weight .medium, color NSColor(white: 1, alpha: 0.40), centered at (canvasW/2, 246)
Preview icon labels 'Droppy Code' and 'Applications' in systemFont ofSize 12, color textPrimary, centered at icon center y + iconSize/2 + 12
Preview icons drawn into a 128x128 rect centered at (165, 208) and (495, 208)
feature_notes: Usage string written to stderr: 'usage: generate_installer_background.swift <output-directory> [path/to/AppIcon.icns]' followed by exit(64)

Header comment declares this file the single source of truth for the geometry shared with the pre-baked .DS_Store: window content 660x370, icon centers (165, 208) and (495, 208), icon size 128, and says the .DS_Store must be re-baked if any of those change
Shaft and chevron are stroked as ONE path in ONE operation because with a translucent stroke color separate strokes would double the alpha at the vertex and render a brighter blob on the tip

Arrow clearance comment: painted-pixel clearance is an equal 34pt on both sides, measured against the app icon case right edge x = 215.5 and the folder body left edge x = 431 + 5 = 436, with the 1.25pt round-cap overhang accounted for
The optional icon argument is chosen as CommandLine.arguments.dropFirst(2).first { $0.hasSuffix(".icns") }, so it can appear anywhere after the output directory
render() flips the context with translateBy(x: 0, y: pixelH) and scaleBy(x: scale, y: -scale) so layout constants read naturally in a top-left origin
Comment notes the 1x and 2x PNGs are combined into a hidpi TIFF by the caller (tiffutil), not by this script
unresolved_questions: The measured edges in the arrow comment (app icon case right edge 215.5, folder body left edge 436) come from the specific macOS icon artwork and cannot be re-derived from this file alone.
Whether the preview composite's respectFlipped: true icon draw matches Finder's own icon rendering exactly is not verifiable from source.

files.purpose: The pre-baked Finder .DS_Store for the release DMG volume, stored base64-encoded at 76 columns so it lives in git as reviewable text; package_dmg.sh decodes it to /.DS_Store on every DMG so Finder shows the designed window geometry, icon-view options, background image and icon positions.
key_symbols: Buddy allocator container: 4-byte magic 0x00000001 followed by 'Bud1'; decoded payload is 16388 bytes
calls_into: Consumed by scripts/package_dmg.sh, which decodes it onto the DMG as /.DS_Store and checks it contains /Volumes/Droppy Code
The icvp backgroundImageAlias resolves /Volumes/Droppy Code/.background.tiff, i.e. the staged installer-background.tiff
state_owned: bwsp blob, a bplist dict of 9 keys: ContainerShowSidebar=false, PreviewPaneVisibility=false, ShowPathbar=false, ShowSidebar=false, ShowStatusBar=false, ShowTabView=false, ShowToolbar=false, SidebarWidth=180, WindowBounds='{{420, 240}, {660, 398}}'

icvp blob, a bplist dict of 17 keys: arrangeBy='none', backgroundColorBlue=1.0, backgroundColorGreen=1.0, backgroundColorRed=1.0, backgroundImageAlias=<338-byte alias>, backgroundType=2, gridOffsetX=0.0, gridOffsetY=0.0, gridSpacing=100.0, iconSize=128.0, labelOnBottom=true, scrollPositionX=0.0, scrollPositionY=0.0, showIconPreview=false, showItemInfo=false, textSize=12.0, viewOptionsVersion=1
Iloc for 'Applications': x = 0x000001ef (495), y = 0x000000d0 (208), then six 0xff bytes and 0x0000 padding
Iloc for 'Droppy Code.app': x = 0x000000a5 (165), y = 0x000000d0 (208), then six 0xff bytes and 0x0000 padding
side_effects: None by itself; it is data. Decoded onto a mounted volume as /.DS_Store, Finder reads it and applies the window styling.
platform_assumptions: macOS Finder .DS_Store binary format: Bud1 buddy allocator plus a B-tree of records keyed by a UTF-16BE filename, a 4-character structure id and a 4-character type
Apple binary property lists (bplist00) inside the bwsp and icvp blobs

A Carbon-era alias record for the background image containing the volume name 'Droppy Code', the filename '.background.tiff', the HFS-style path 'Droppy Code:.background.tiff', the POSIX path '/.background.tiff' and the mount point '/Volumes/Droppy Code'
The alias carries the throwaway bake volume's creation timestamp (0xe6d1a6f2 for the volume, 0xe6d1a6f3 for the file), and Finder still resolves it by volume name plus path
A record filename of '.' means the settings apply to the volume root folder itself
persisted_fields: ContainerShowSidebar / PreviewPaneVisibility / ShowPathbar / ShowSidebar / ShowStatusBar / ShowTabView / ShowToolbar: boolean false
backgroundColorRed / backgroundColorGreen / backgroundColorBlue: real 1.0 each, unused while backgroundType is 2
Iloc blob layout: 4-byte x, 4-byte y, then 0xffff 0xffff 0xffff and 0x0000
ui_elements: Mounted DMG window placed at (420, 240) with outer size 660x398
Icon view with 128pt icons, 12pt labels below icons, an image background, and no toolbar, status bar, tab bar, pathbar or sidebar
'Droppy Code.app' icon centered at (165, 208); 'Applications' symlink icon centered at (495, 208)
feature_notes: Exactly 6 B-tree records, in this order: '.'/bwsp/blob, '.'/icvl/type, '.'/icvp/blob, '.'/vSrn/long, 'Applications'/Iloc/blob, 'Droppy Code.app'/Iloc/blob
The literal string '/Volumes/Droppy Code' is present, which is exactly what the README's verification grep requires and what package_dmg.sh enforces
Encoded at 76 base64 characters per line (base64 -b 76) over 288 lines; the decoded payload is 16388 bytes and the last line ends with 'AAA='
The alias also stores UTF-16 forms of '.background.tiff' and 'Droppy Code' plus the HFS-style path 'Droppy Code:.background.tiff'
Most of the file is zero padding from the 16 KiB buddy-allocator container, which is why 288 lines of base64 carry only six records
unresolved_questions: The working-tree copy in this Windows checkout has CRLF line terminators (git ls-files --eol reports i/lf w/crlf for all four text files in release/dmg), so the sha256 recorded here is of the CRLF working-tree bytes; the upstream macOS file is LF and would hash differently.
The six 0xff bytes trailing each Iloc record are the conventional undocumented fields of the Iloc structure; their meaning cannot be established from this file.
The alias's embedded volume creation date 0xe6d1a6f2 identifies the throwaway bake volume, but it cannot be converted to a calendar date with certainty from these files alone.
